newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ADR telecoms rise on BT deal.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ADR telecoms rise on BT deal.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc soared in New York on Monday with news of a multibillion-dollar merger with MCI Communications Corp and helped pull other foreign telecommunications stocks higher, traders said.
British Telecom American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose 5-3/4 to 61-1/4 in late-morning trade. The boost in British Telecom stock has raised the merger's value to $21.5 billion.
"The market has been very positive to BT," a trader said, adding, "But people are questioning the long-term strategic logic of the overlap of the two companies."

Britain's telecoms group Vodafone Group Plc was up one point to 38-3/4 on hopes that the United States' AT&T Corp might make a similar bid for it. AT&T has declined to comment on market rumors of an offer for the mobile phone company.
Cable and Wireless Plc was off 3/8 to 23-3/4 and analysts said the stock was unlikely to attract a takeover bid similar to the British Telecom offer.
Australia's News Corp rose 1/8 to 22-5/8, helped by sentiment that MCI would be unlikely to sell its investment in the media company.
Oil stocks eased on falling oil prices, with British Petroleum Plc off 1/8 to 125-5/8.
Latin American stocks were largely quiet ahead of Tuesday's elections in the United States. Argentine stocks steadied on encouraging results from tax returns, with Telecom Argentina up 1/4 to 38-1/8.
Israel's Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd gained one point to 20-1/2 after it reported third-quarter earnings of $0.33 a share, up from $0.27 a year ago.
